name: Comic Con Manchester
blurb: Monopoly Events' pop culture convention at Bowlers Exhibition Centre, Manchester, separate from the MCM-brand Comic Con shows.

editions.evidence: Homepage: '24-25th July, 2027 BEC Arena, Manchester' and body text 'our home venue, Bowlers Exhibition Centre in Manchester'.

notes: The browser tab title is a stale 'Trafford Centre' meta title, but the page's own date banner ('BEC Arena') and body copy ('Bowlers Exhibition Centre') agree, so that is the venue used ('BEC' = Bowlers Exhibition Centre). Annual show (site copy: 'attracting over ten thousand fans annually'), confirming the seed note. The guests page shows only a single 'TBC' placeholder tile with no names - guests is 'none-yet'. 'In previous years' text namedrops Tyler Hoechlin, Zachary Quinto, Seth Green, Zachary Levi and Elisabeth Berkley, but that is marketing copy about past shows, not a confirmed 2027 lineup. Organizer Monopoly Events confirmed by the shared Wix template/footer and the seed note.
